nodes.name: Every 5 minutes
nodes.notes: Replies are answers to a person who is waiting, so this runs far more often than the outreach sender. It is NOT a prospecting schedule: it only transmits messages a human has already written and queued, and it sends nothing when the queue is empty.

nodes.name: Collect queued replies
nodes.notes: Each reply is handed out ONCE and marked collected in the same step. If this workflow dies before submitting, that reply is not sent and sits in the CMS for a person — rather than being mailed twice, which cannot be undone.

nodes.name: Submit to private Postfix
nodes.notes: Needs NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_EXTERNAL=nodemailer on the n8n container. Without it this node fails and the reply is reported failed rather than silently lost.

nodes.name: Confirm sent
nodes.notes: This is also what puts the reply into the thread the operator reads. Recording it at compose time would show a message as sent that may never have been transmitted.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ error: String($json.error && $json.error.message || $json.error || 'Submission failed').slice(0, 900), retryable: false }) }}

nodes.name: Report failure
nodes.notes: retryable:false on purpose. A reply that silently re-queued forever would mail the same person repeatedly the moment a fault cleared. A failed reply is visible in the CMS and a person decides.
